irAndReserveTracker.name: James Conner
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 14 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Conner hasn't played in a game since Week 3 of last season, when he sustained a right foot/ankle injury that required surgery. Though he was able to participate in individual drills in training camp, he never advanced to team work before being placed on injured reserve with a designation to return Aug. 30. The Cardinals still haven't cleared Conner to practice nearly three months later, which suggests that he either experienced a setback over the summer or plateaued in his recovery. Whatever the case, Conner doesn't seem close to a return, and the chances of him playing at any point this season will grow dimmer with each week that he doesn't practice.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Gardner Minshew II
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Though the procedure will bring an end to Minshew's season, he's expected to make a full recovery ahead of the 2027 campaign. The veteran quarterback sustained the injury while making his lone start of the season Week 9 in Seattle, but he played though the elbow issue and completed 21 of 30 passes for 166 yards. Rookie third-round pick Carson Beck took over as the Cardinals' starting quarterback in Week 10 and is expected to lead the offense for the remainder of the season.

irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: This move was a foregone conclusion, as head coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Burch will miss the remainder of the campaign after suffering an MCL injury to his left knee. The defensive end finished his sophomore NFL season with 19 tackles, including 1.0 sacks, over 10 games. Burch will now look to get healthy in the hope of being ready for the 2027 campaign.
